scene: A turning point and a standing person create uncertainty near the T-junction.

objects.reason: The turning point can hide crossing traffic before the robot commits to the turn.
The person is standing beyond the turning point and could step into the shared space.

navigation_context_used.lidar_summary: Front-left has uncertainty at the turning point and front-right has a person-sized soft return.
navigation_context_used.depth_summary: The turning point is closer to the robot, while the standing person is deeper beyond the corner.

navigation_advice: Give extra clearance to the turning point and nearby person while entering the junction.
